about_content:
GuardianSuit chirongwa chitsva, chinopindura uye chine mifananidzo cheCaptive Portal cheOPNsense. Chinopa vashandisi chiitiko chinofadza chekupinda, uye vatariri kutonga kuzere pamusoro pechitarisiko nekushanda kwepeji yekugamuchira.

Zvimiro zvikuru:

  • Kupindura uye mifananidzo.
  • Mitauro yakawanda.
  • Kugadzirisa zviri nyore chitarisiko nemavara.
  • UX inooneka uye kutevedzera WCAG.
  • Kubatanidzwa zviri nyore neOPNsense.

Kushandiswa:
Yakanakira etiweki dzemakambani, mahotera, makafé nemamwe nzvimbo dzinoda peji yekugamuchira yeCaptive Portal inoyevedza.

Munyori: Mirosław Majka <mix@proask.pl> | © 2025 GuardianSuit
cookies_content:
Chii chinonzi faira re-cookie?

Mafaira e-cookies (anonziwo ma-cookies) mafaira madiki emavara, anoumbwa otomatiki nebrowser ye-paanduneti paunoshanya masaiti e-WWW. Mashoko ari mufaira re-cookie anogona kuverengwa chete nesaiti iyo faira rinobva. Naizvozvo saiti yepaanduneti haikwanise kuwana mamwe mafaira ari pakomputa yemushandisi.

Nekuda kwemashoko ari mumafaira e-cookies saiti "inoziva" nenzira yauri kuishandisa nayo uye inogona kugadzirisa zvinoratidzwa kwauri kana kukupa rubatsiro.

Tinoshandisirei mafaira e-cookies?

Pawebhusaiti tinoshandisa mafaira e-cookies ehunjiniya, ayo anodiwa kuti saiti isebenze zvakanaka. Tinoshandisa iwo kuti tikwenenzere webhusaiti yedu maererano nemidziyo nemabrowser anonyanya kushandiswa nevanhu vanoshanya - saka komputa yako, piritsi kana foni zvicharatidza zvakanaka uye zvichayeuka kana wabvuma kuratidzwa kwezvimwe zvirimo pawebhusaiti.

Mushandisi haagoni kuramba mafaira e-cookies ehunjiniya.

Tinoshandisa mafaira e-cookies kwenguva yakareba sei?

Tinoshandisa anonzi mafaira e-cookie asingachinje, anoramba ari pamudziyo wako kwenguva yakati kana kusvikira wawabvisa nemaoko.

Ndeapi mashoko ataunganidza kuburikidza nemafaira e-cookies?

Nekushandisa tekinoroji ye-cookie tinounganidza pamusoro pako mashoko ehunjiniya asingazivikanwe chete, anoshandira kuvandudza kunakidza kwekushandisa saiti yedu.

Hatiri kuunganidza chero mashoko anobvumira kuzivikanwa kwako. Mashoko chete emushandisi, ayo pasina kubatana nemamwe mashoko asingabvumiri kuzivikanwa kwake, ndiyo kero ye-IP iyo mushandisi anobatanidza nayo.
privacy_content:
Tiri kugadzira gwaro iri kukuzivisa nezveMitemo Yedu Yekuvanzika. Pano uchaona tiri ani, mabatiro atinoita, mashandisiro, kubudisa uye kugovana mashoko emunhu mukati me < Zita reISP >, ine mahofisi pa [ Zita remugwagwa 10, guta uye kodhi yetsamba ], chinangwa chatinozvitiitira uye nzira iyo vanhu vatinogadzirisa mashoko avo vanogona kushandisa nayo kodzero dzavo dzekuvanzika.

< Zita reISP > ndiyo ine mhosva yekugadzirisa mashoko emunhu zvinoenderana neMitemo Yekuvanzika iyi.

PAMUSORO PEDU

Mutungamiri, kureva sangano rinogadzirisa mashoko emunhu maererano nekushandisa kwauri kuita sevhisi iyi, ndi < Zita reISP >, [ Zita remugwagwa 10, guta uye kodhi yetsamba ]; NIP 1234567890, Regon 123456789,

BATA NESU
  • pamapepa e-email: adres@email.pl,
  • panyora pakero: Zita reISP, [ Zita remugwagwa 10, guta uye kodhi yetsamba ]
MITEMO INOWANIKWA MUMITEMO YEKUVANZIKA IYI

Tinochengetedza kuti kugadzirisa mashoko ako kuitike zvinoenderana nemitemo yeEuropean Parliament and Council Regulation (EU) No 2016/679 ya27 Kubvumbi 2016 pamusoro pekudzivirirwa kwevanhu panyaya yekugadziriswa kwemashoko emunhu uye kufamba kwakasununguka kwemashoko akadaro uye kubviswa kweDirective 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation) (pano yainzi: “GDPR”), mutemo wekudzivirirwa kwemashoko emunhu, pamwe chete nemitemo yakakosha. Mitemo Yekuvanzika iyi yakagadzirirwa zvinoenderana nayo. Tinonyatsotsanangura nzira yatinounganidza nayo mashoko emunhu uye chinangwa chatinoshandisa iwo.

Tinotsinhira kuti < Zita reISP >, inounganidza mashoko emunhu nemashoko ekambani anopiwa nevatengi (vangangoita vatengi) nevabatsiri, pamwe chete nemashoko anowanikwa panguva yekushandisa sevhisi yekuwana andaneti.

KUUNGANIDZWA KWEKWASHOKO KWEVANHU

Tinounganidza mashoko emunhu anopiwa neVashandisi muzviitiko zvinotevera:

  • kuisa zvinopiwa, kuseta mamiriro ekubatana uye/kana kupa mashoko pamusoro pemasevhisi nezvimwe zviito zve < Zita reISP >,
  • kupinda nekuzadzisa zvibvumirano uye kuchengetedza kubatana nemutengi/mubatsiri,
  • kuita zvisungo zvinobva mumitemo inoshanda yose,
  • kupindura mibvunzo, kutarisa zvichemo nezvimwe zvinodiwa mushure mekutengesa,
  • ushambadzi wakanangana (kunze kwe newsletter),
  • zvinangwa zvekuchengetera (zveuchapupu), kugadzirisa zvinogona kuitika, kuita zvichemo kana kuzvidzivirira kubva pazvichemo.
KUCHENGETA KWEKWASHOKO NEKUBVISA

Nekuda kwekuchengeteka kwemashoko akaiswa takaumba nzira dzemukati nemazano zvinofanira kudzivirira kubudiswa kwemashoko kune vanhu vasina mvumo. Tinoshandisa nzira dzehunjiniya, zvibvumirano, dzekutonga uye dzemuviri kudzivirira mashoko kubva pakusvikirwa pasina mvumo. Tinodzora kuita kwadzo uye tisingaregi kutarisa kuti dzinotevedzera mitemo yakakodzera here.

Tinochengeta mashoko emunhu emushandisi kwenguva inodiwa chete kuzadzisa zvinangwa zvawakatorerwa.

KUGABANA NEKUBUDITSA KWEMASHOKO

Hatitengesi kana kugovera kune vanhu vechitatu mashoko emunhu evashandisi pasina mvumo yavo. Mashoko evashandisi haaiti zvine chekuita nekupenda (profiling).

MITEMO YATINOGADZIRISA NAYO MASHOKO AKO

Tinoita neparinogona napo kudzivirira zvido zvevanhu vanogadzirirwa mashoko avo emunhu, uye kunyanya kuona kuti mashoko aya:

  • anogadzirisa zvinoenderana nemitemo, nenzira yakanaka uye yakajeka kune munhu wacho,
  • akaunganidzwa muzvinangwa zvakati, zvakajeka uye zviri pamutemo uye haana kugadzirirwa mberi nenzira isingaenderani nezvinangwa izvozvo,
  • akakodzera, akakwana uye akaganhurirwa kune zvinodiwa pakuzadzisa zvinangwa zvaari kugadzirirwa,
  • akarurama uye kana zvichidiwa anoiswa panguva. Tinoita zviito zvekuti mashoko emunhu asina kururama maererano nezvinangwa zvekugadzirisa kwawo, abviswe pakarepo kana kugadziriswa,
  • akachengetwa nenzira inobvumira kuzivikanwa kwemunhu wacho, kwenguva isingapfuure inodiwa kuzadzisa zvinangwa zvekugadzirisa,
  • anogadzirisa nenzira inovimbisa kuchengeteka kwakakodzera kwemashoko emunhu, kusanganisira kudzivirira kugadzirisa kusiri pamutemo kana kusingabvumirwi uye kurasikirwa kana kuparadzwa zvisina tsarukano.
KODZERO DZAKO

Une kodzero dzinotevera:

  • Kuwana zvirimo mumashoko ako emunhu uye kuwana mashoko pakati pemamwe akati wandei emhando dzemashoko, zvinangwa zvekugadzirisa, pamwe chete kuwana kopa yawo,
  • Kugadzirisa mashoko asina kururama nekuzadza asipo, pamwe chete nekukanganwika, zvichireva kuti une kodzero yekubvisa mashoko anogadzirisa pasina hwaro uye pasiri pamutemo (semuenzaniso mashoko haachadiwi kune zvinangwa zvakaunganidzirwa),
  • Kubvisa mvumo yekugadzirisa mashoko chero nguva pasina kukanganisa pamutemo kwekugadzirisa kwakaitwa zvichibva pamvumo isati yabviswa (kana kugadzirisa kuchibva paArticle 6(1)(a) kana Article 9(2)(a) yeGDPR).
COOKIES

< Zita reISP >, inoshandisa mafaira e-cookie kuita kuti kushandisa sevhisi kuve nyore. Nekushandisa sevhisi unobvumira kushandiswa kwemafaira e-cookie nesu. Kana usingavhare mafaira aya unobvumira kushandiswa kwawo uye kuchengetwa mumndangariro yemudziyo

SHANDUKO DZEMITEMO YEKUDZIVIRIRWA KWEMASHOKO EMNUNHU

< Zita reISP > inochengetera kodzero yekuchinja mitemo yekudzivirirwa kwemashoko emunhu, iyo inogona kukanganiswa nekuvandudzwa kwetekinoroji ye-paanduneti, shanduko dzinogona kuitika dzemutemo maererano nekudzivirirwa kwemashoko emunhu nekukura kwesevhisi yekuwanikwa inopihwa nemutungamiri. Tichazivisa nezveshanduko dzose nenzira yakajeka uye iri nyore kuverenga.
